faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes Vito 110/111 CDI use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. From 1996 to 2003 (W638 generation), it used the OM601 2.2-litre diesel. From 2003 to 2006 (early W639), it used the OM611. From 2006 to 2014 (facelift W639), it switched to the OM646. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your van has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes Vito 110/111 CDI engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for any of the engine codes. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Vito 110/111 CDI?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM601, OM611 or OM646 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM601 Vito 110/111 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. No specific known issue is confirmed for this application, but we service it to the same standard as our other Vito rebuilds.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM611 Vito 110/111 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. No specific known issue is confirmed for this application, but we service it to the same standard as our other Vito rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild OM646 Vito 110/111 CDI engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM646 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Vito 110/111 CDI engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Vito 110/111 CDI if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Vito 110/111 CDI engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Vito 110/111 CDI owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
